disease_state: The AAA-ATPase Drg1 is a key factor in eukaryotic ribosome biogenesis that initiates cytoplasmic maturation of the large ribosomal subunit.
material_type: Crude extracts were prepared by breaking the cells in a Merkenschlager bead mill in the presence of 0.6 mm glass beads (4 minutes with CO2 cooling every 30 seconds) in buffer A (20 mM HEPES-NaOH, pH 7.5, 10 mM KCl, 2.5 mM MgCl2, 1 mM EGTA, 1 mM DTT, 0.5 mM PMSF and protease-inhibitor-mix FY (Serva)).
sample_source: Pre-60S particles were isolated from a LmB-sensitive S. cerevisiae mutant strain (crm1T539C) using Bud20-TAP as bait.
species: Here, we report a series of cryo-EM structures that captured the extraction of Rlp24 from pre-60S particles by Saccharomyces cerevisiae Drg1.
